name: Metal Support
description: The Metal backend's Linux-safe parts (Sources/CoreRender/Metal): binary16 half-float conversion for filling rgba16Float textures from Float32 buffers and reading them back; MetalCapabilities, the proven op set and health state the dispatcher routes on; SurfaceTiling, the 256 px tile grid a surface's textures follow, with the tiles a rect touches; and later pipeline cache keys. Pure Swift bit and integer math, no Metal import, so it builds, tests and mutates on Linux.
